title: Route Zephyr fleet through RenodeServer
description: ec2-hetero-fleet.sh points SX1262.cs Renode nodes at generic SimulatorServer/NodeServer port 5555, which requires REGISTER first, while SX1262.cs sends TX first and is intentionally a no-REGISTER client. Start and assign per-node RenodeServer endpoints as scripts/renode-multinode.py does, preserving shared simulation traffic.
acceptance_criteria: Every Zephyr/Renode node connects to a documented RenodeServer endpoint; no TX-before-REGISTER rejection occurs; Python, Rust, and Zephyr nodes share one simulation and exchange frames; process failures fail closed; three reviews pass.
notes: Implemented deterministic per-Zephyr RenodeServer endpoints (default ports 6000+index) on the shared hetero-mesh simulation; EC2 Renode scripts now target their assigned no-REGISTER endpoint, wait for all bridge connections, and fail closed on coordinator/local/remote process failure. Local runner now reports bridge ports and fails on early Renode exit. Validation: bash -n main and generated remote script; generated hetero-sim Python compile; py_compile; Ruff; python/tests/sim/test_renode_server.py 16/16; live generated coordinator probe sent TX as first message and received TX_DONE without REGISTER. AWS fleet not launched for this focused fix.
close_reason: Implemented shared-simulation per-node RenodeServer routing with fail-closed startup/runtime supervision; focused local validation green.
